subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Survey
solution:
The correct answer is **'Scrutinise'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word **'Survey' **is** 'Scrutinise'.**
 
• **Survery**: a study of the opinions, behaviour, etc. of a group of people. (व्‍यक्तियों के किसी समूह के विचारों, आचरण आदि का अध्ययन; सर्वेक्षण)
 
 
• *Example: to carry out/conduct/do a **survey**...*
 
 
 
• **Scrutinise**: to look at or examine something carefully. [(किसी वस्‍तु को) सावधानी से देखना या जाँचना]
 
 
• *Example: The customs official **scrutinized** every page of my passport.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Scrutinise.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Disregard**: to pay no attention to. (उपेक्षा)
 
• **Slothful**: lazy, indolent, slothful mean not easily aroused to activity. (आलसी)
 
• **Apathy**: lack of feeling or emotion. (उदासीनता)
